summary: Resolved the snapshot-save question by tracing the enclosing control flow. The snapshot worker panics on a hard node.save error with no recover around workerMain/handle (the engine recover is limited to step workers under error injection and nodehost.go's recover covers only NodeHost.Start), so no live node keeps a suppressing save state; on every non-fatal path saveDone records completion, the apply worker's processStatusTransition clears the saving flag, and later periodic snapshots remain enabled. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, answered the registered gap as resolved, and added two behavior entries. Source argument only, with blocking Save and non-panic error policies left as stated limits.
